args.body:
• Spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, and fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• The companion piece (subscriber content) notes that shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
• Combined takeaway: pricing leverage is shifting toward shippers on the spot market, but carrier-mix strategy matters more than locking a single contract.
args.title: Bellwether Freight Q Summary
